run_tcp_connect: run the script to open a TCP handshake to a specified server host and port
run_tcp_connect_with_timeout: run the script with a custom timeout to connect to a server and exit after N seconds
test_tcp_connection: test connectivity to a server by running the script with a host and port argument
review_main_function: review the main function that parses CLI args and opens a TCP connection using socket.create_connection
summarize_tcp_connect_script: summarize the tcp_connect script that opens a TCP connection to a server and then exits
